plans.idea: Classic centred story stack: brand lockup on top, a large bottle as the focal centre, then headline, copy and a prominent full-width CTA pill, reading top to bottom without the current version's CTA clashing with the logo at the top and its empty lower half.

Text-first editorial layout on a shared left edge, keeping the original's left-aligned typography: logo, then a big headline, copy and CTA in the upper half, with the bottle filling the lower half as the payoff.

Hero-led poster: the bottle fills the top half as the opening image, the headline and copy sit centred beneath it, then the CTA, with the logo lockup closing the story at the bottom as a brand sign-off.
